title: AI keys screen (client): save key, detect or choose provider, pick model, test, remove
description: Screen next to pluggy-keys (client/src/features, route in app/(budget)). Paste key, provider is detected and can be changed, then models from that provider are listed to choose; test and remove. Shows when the shared server AI is available instead. Strings through t() with pt-BR. Plan, decisions and owner answers: handoff.md at the repo root. Mock: tk show budget-seoa (evidence ev-c96ced overview, PNGs). Follow AGENTS.md (contracts, migrations additive only + MIGRATION_SIGNATURES, i18n, ports, test DB rules).
notes:
Built the client AI key screen (/ai-keys). Feature client/src/features/ai-keys/ (screen, form, saved/shared cards, thin hook, tested aiKeys.logic.ts, en+pt-BR catalogs). RTK slice client/src/budget/data/api/ai.ts over the shared ai contracts (status, save, delete, test, detect, list models). Settings entry next to Linked banks, hidden tab route, FAB suppressed. Checks: bunx tsc --noEmit 0 errors; bunx eslint . 0 errors, 0 warnings; bun test 1284 pass / 0 fail (98 files). Web proof at 1400 and 375 against the real local API with a stateful /ai/* stub proxy (fake keys, no real provider): empty, detected provider + model list, saved+tested, bad-key error, shared server AI, manual Z.ai pick, remove notice. Two commits; found and fixed a real bug in the run: mutation triggers changing identity restarted the detection effect and left 'Detecting provider…' forever.
Follow-up for budget-ucyr (read via git show tk/budget-ucyr, not merged): 'ai_key_forbidden' (403) now has its own message (en+pt-BR); the client matches the fixed wire value with a documented local constant because the ucyr contract/errors constant is not on this branch yet. The model is optional at save time: when listing models returns 403 (or any error) the form shows the explanation, offers a typed model id, keeps a chosen model across Retry, and lets Save store the key without a model. The saved card explains a model-less key that was saved because listing was forbidden (survives the post-save provider reset). Z.ai's static list needs no client change: /ai/models serves it. Verified in the browser with a stub: restricted key -> 403 explanation + manual field + Save without model -> saved card explanation; typed model + Save -> the same 403 message; normal key + model still saves. Checks: bunx tsc --noEmit 0 errors; bunx eslint . 0 errors, 0 warnings; bun test 1286 pass / 0 fail. Evidence: ev-7bc2d4, ev-925ebc, ev-ef2a74, ev-885562, ev-9aa127, ev-227a9d.
Aligned with the final ai contracts after ucyr f34eb55 (read via git show; not merged). Removed ai_key_forbidden end to end: local constant, en/pt-BR keyForbidden string, modelsForbidden/savedForbidden flags and their resets, saved-card forbidden explanation, tests. Errors now branch on the body code only: the nine contract codes plus rate_limited and upstream_error each have an en/pt-BR message; a 429/502 without its code falls back to the generic sentence, never a status guess. Status: own non-null + effective null renders 'saved key can no longer be opened on this server... Save the key again' (ownKeyUnreadable, saved card); shared AI shows only when shared.available is true (mode test). Z.ai: the model combobox offers a 'Use "<typed id>"' row plus a hint, so a typed id outside the suggestion list can be saved; /ai/models and save now accept it server-side. Kept: optional model, manual model field and save-without-model when the list fails (verified with a 429 list-unavailable stub). Checks: bunx tsc --noEmit 0 errors; bunx eslint . 0 errors, 0 warnings; bun test 1287 pass / 0 fail. New evidence: ev-d957a1, ev-ec7262, ev-6c0914, ev-13ecbc, ev-4514d5, ev-91edcc, ev-c1b354. Obsolete and detached: ev-7bc2d4, ev-925ebc, ev-ef2a74, ev-885562, ev-9aa127, ev-227a9d (the forbidden case).
Independent review (attached review-dcxr.md): 5 must-fix, 12 follow-ups; sent back to the omp session. Not approved.
Review fixes (review-dcxr.md), all in client/src. 1) useAiKeys.ts model-list effect: 600ms debounce after detection settles, shouldListModels() gate (tested), cleanup aborts the request, sequence id keeps stale answers/resets away. 2) aiKeyForm.logic.ts effectiveModel(): typed text is the model on Save for Z.ai and for the retryable manual field; tested; verified saving glm-5.3-flashx-custom without tapping Use. 3) aiKeys.logic.ts: own+effective null keeps the unreadable card (comment says it needs ucyr's ownKeyUsable); own null+effective null+shared available is 'blocked' (BlockedAiCard) and never 'shared AI in use'; tested. 4) AiKeySavedCard.tsx uses useMoneyFormat().formatDate (screenshot: Saved 24/11/2026). 5) ui/primitives/settingsCard.tsx + ui/PasswordField.tsx; both PluggyKeysCard and the AI cards use them; Pluggy before/after PNGs are byte-identical (md5 at 1400 and 375); PasswordField moved cleanly with a credential mode (autocomplete=new-password) used by both secret fields. 7) modelListFailure(): manual field/Retry/save-without only for rate_limited, upstream_error, network; ai_key_rejected shows only the message. 8) detect finally resets only for its own sequence; cleanup aborts. 9) runCredentialAction(): ref guard + reset on settle; tested (double tap, args cleared). 10) aiKeyForm.logic.ts reducer + 19 tests; useAiKeys function is ~250 lines. 11) aiErrorKey pinned per code; runCredentialAction store-args test; invalid_input/upstream_timeout; pt-BR spot check. 12) Z.ai hint corrected and moved above the picker. 14) chips are a 44pt radio group; errors/notices are polite live regions; detection hint is the key field's accessibilityHint; SettingsCardButton/IndigoButton announce disabled. 15) autocomplete=new-password on both secret fields via the shared PasswordField. 16) error.unreachable removed; apiErrorMessage handles the network case. Review 2 fixes (review-dcxr-2.md). 1) Must-fix: canSaveAiKey + isModelListPending in aiKeyForm.logic.ts (tested: detection running, debounce window, loading, loaded, failed); useAiKeys computes canSave/modelsPending and AiKeyForm's loading line and Save disabled state read the same flag, so the paste→list window cannot save a key with no model. Browser: Save aria-disabled=true while 'Loading models…' then enabled after the list (ev-50ac52, ev-987f6b). 2) useFocusEffect cleanup in useAiKeys.ts resets key/editing/error/notice/test/confirm on blur and in usePluggyKeys.ts clears client id/secret/error/notice/confirm/replacing; the effects' cleanups abort detect/list. Browser 375: typed key (ev-e4234e) → Plan tab → in-app back with the window marker preserved (no reload) → field empty (ev-27fe6d); Pluggy typed (ev-1f0fdf) → same → both fields empty (ev-2f6b80). The 1400 focus pair is not attached: the desktop rail link is a document navigation, so that sequence cannot distinguish a remount; the 375 tab switch is the mounted-screen proof. 3) localDatePart() in aiKeys.logic.ts feeds formatDate; stub updated_at 2026-11-24T22:00:00-03:00 shows Saved 24/11/2026, not the UTC 25/11 (ev-e2163b, ev-bb096e). 4) detectionHint returns null when a provider is chosen and nothing was detected; form.providerChosen removed from en/pt-BR (ev-a7dea9, ev-bebdce). 5) Chose 'keep the previous choice': modelQueryEdited keeps the pick for list-driven providers (only clearing the field unchoses); Z.ai typed text still replaces the pick; tested. Browser: picked Claude Sonnet 4.5, edited the field to 'claude-sonnet', Save stored claude-sonnet-4-5 (ev-bb096e). 6) editKey clears the notice; browser: remove → 'Key removed.' → type a bad key → error with no stale notice (ev-5f7614, ev-ccc66a). 7) The unreadable card shows only Save a new key and Remove, no Test (ev-390463, ev-445b55). 8) Comments: ownKeyUnreadable is reachable now that ucyr is on main; detection is a server call; the screen/hook say the key is held only while focused.
